semanticOwner: JsonVersionManagerStateStore.GetDefaultPath remains the sole version-manager default-path resolver and gains a guard before LOCALAPPDATA/platform resolution. CompositionHostServices retains ownership of its separate four-file directory resolver; both read the same switch, whose single literal moves to an internal JsonVersionManagerStateStore constant and whose Bootstrap constant remains an alias. The two existing launcher parsers merely defer fallback until explicit path parsing and validation finish. CliApplication's existing internal composition overload accepts an optional explicit state path only for version-self-test; CliTestHarness injects the path without replacing the production graph, policy, Registry adapter or discovery.
terminalContract: With the NvtFwCombiner.LocalState.CurrentUserFolderForbidden switch true, every in-process default GetDefaultPath call throws InvalidOperationException before LOCALAPPDATA, platform-folder or state IO. With switch unset/false, LOCALAPPDATA wins over platform-folder with the existing null-only fallback and path validation; version-manager.v1.json and its lock/scratch paths are unchanged. Explicit state paths bypass this guard, including through both launcher parsers after their argument validation. The public CLI overload has the same signature and uses the default resolver for version-self-test; the internal overload has optional string? versionManagerStatePath = null after CancellationToken, and CliTestHarness injects a per-invocation path beneath its isolated directory. Existing zero-argument Bootstrap success, explicit-path success, unknown/empty argument errors, Registry adapter observations and redaction all retain coverage; the actual private Launcher parser has direct switch-true behavioral coverage for explicit-path bypass, omitted-path refusal, and unknown/missing/empty argument errors via a test-only Launcher project reference; separate tests cover switch-true default refusal. Product child processes with their own runtimeconfig are outside the test-process guarantee. The four already isolated files, firmware bytes/ranges/CRC/profiles/output naming, and state file format do not change. ADR 0079 receives a dated extension without rewriting sealed history.

designReview.evidence: Independent third-round read-only R2 design review by codex/gpt-6-astra, independent of implementationOwner codex/gpt-6-sol, against source f3857d6f1cf95a124cb580a011c5e9deac0527c7 with a clean worktree. Round 1 was BLOCKED by eager default resolution in both launcher parsers, omission of the switch-literal architecture-test migration, and loss of production zero-argument success coverage. Round 2 confirmed those corrections but returned ACCEPT-WITH-CHANGES for one P2 gap: source-order assertions alone could not prove explicit-path bypass in Launcher.Program.Parse. Version 3 closes that design gap by requiring reflective invocation of the actual private parser through a test-only Launcher project reference, covering explicit-path success, omitted-path InvalidOperationException, and preserved unknown-option, missing-value and empty-path ArgumentException behavior under switch=true. It specifies exception unwrapping, nonparallel execution, finally-based switch restoration, and guard-first intermediate red evidence that detects eager resolution even after the option loop. Required project/test paths and the ADR amendment are included; all earlier corrections remain intact. No new findings were identified. Verdict: APPROVED; recommended designReview.outcome: findings-incorporated. Scoped design Polytail: PASS. This approves the revised design only; implementation, focused test execution, independent fixed-head final review and integration remain pending. Inspection used read-only Git, source/document searches and SHA-256 hashing. No files or Git state were modified, and no build, tests, verifier or network operations were performed.
